purpose: Builds and owns the one MarmotClient per account: signer adapter (fromForeignSigner/APPLESAUCE_SHAPE, budgets, nip44 + secure-context gates), SimplePool transport, per-account IndexedDB stores + lease, createMarmotClient with timing options, ordered startup (listeners, inbox handlers, groups.list, group notifications, inbox.start, key-package ensure, injected kind-10050 ensure), owned setTimeout(0) FIFO, teardown.

public_api.name: bootstrapAccountClient
public_api.description: Runs the gated, ordered startup; resolves ready | unsupported(insecure-context|nip44) | lease-held; throws TypeError for a missing collaborator; releases everything acquired on a fatal step failure.

public_api.name: AccountClientHandle
public_api.signature: { client: MarmotClient; pubkey: string; leaseHeld: () => boolean; enqueue: ClientJobQueue['enqueue'] }
public_api.description: Seam handle injected into feature modules (exactly these four fields).

public_api.name: AccountClient
public_api.signature: { handle; stores: WritableStores; groups; ensure; attachGroup(group): void; queue: JobQueue; teardown(): Promise<void> }
public_api.description: What a ready bootstrap yields; attachGroup wires the notification listener for groups created/joined later.

public_api.name: ClientJobQueue / createJobQueue
public_api.description: Owned FIFO: setTimeout(0) start, one at a time, enqueue order, rejecting job does not stall.

public_api.name: InboxRelayListEnsure
public_api.signature: { ensure: (ctx: { pubkey: string; relays: string[] }) => Promise<void> }
public_api.description: Port for the kind-10050 ensure; called once, after key-package ensure (policy owned by S16).

public_api.name: createAccountSigner / budgetPolicyFor / signerSupportsNip44
public_api.description: fromForeignSigner(APPLESAUCE_SHAPE) wrap; budget none for local, timeout budget for nip07/nip46.

public_api.name: createClientTransport
public_api.description: createSimplePoolNetwork({pool}).asTransportContract() over an app-owned SimplePool; no verifier; closePool destroys the pool once.

public_api.name: createTeardown
public_api.description: queue dispose, unsubscribe listeners, client.dispose(), await stores.close(), pool close; idempotent; runs every step.

public_api.name: CLIENT_TIMING_OPTIONS / INBOX_HANDLER_KINDS / CLIENT_EVENT_NAMES
public_api.description: leaveTimeoutMs 10000, removalSettleMs 5000; kinds 21059/21064; the six app-visible client events.

owned_data: library account DB marmot:<pubkey> (opaque, library-owned; opened only by client/)
external_ports: injected: HistoryBackend (S3 sink), client event handlers, inbox handlers (21059, 21064), group notification callback, InboxRelayListEnsure (S16)
events_consumed: inbox rumors of kinds 21059 and 21064 (registerInboxHandler, forwarded)
